newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets Banco Republica base price $24 mln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets Banco Republica base price $24 mln.

text.p: Venezuela's National Deposits Guarantee Fund, Fogade, set the auction base price for the mid-sized, state-owned Banco Republica at 11.67 billion bolivars ($24 million), Fogade said.

Fifteen local and international banks -- including the U.S.'s Citibank, investment arm ING Barings of Dutch financial giant Internationale Nederlanden Groep, and Canada's Bank of Nova Scotia -- have pre-registered for the auction due to take place on June 27.
The sale will close the cycle of bank privatizations that opened last year with the high profile sale of leading domestic retail bank Banco de Venezuela to Spain's Banco Santander for $351 million.
